text: Could you draw some balloons for me, floating against a pale blue sky? I’ve had a simple balloon picture in mind for a while and would really like to see it made. There should be exactly three balloons, all red, and the image should be square with no text. Each balloon needs its own dangling string. Please keep the balloons apart so I can count them easily.
